list.title: Basikuyaka amilimo
list.hint: Basikuyaka balanjila mubbuwa lyabasikuyaka kuti batambule bantu kuti bachite milimu yabo mpawo basinizye kuti kuli mabbuku.

detail.deactivateHint: Kulesya kubeleka kupa kuti kufumbwa sikubelesya sikuyaka ooyu azwe ndilyona.
detail.resetPrompt: Pasiwedi mpya ya {{name}} (mabala aatasiki kuli 8). Bayoosainwa koonse koonse.
detail.projectsHint: Beenzuma basala kuzwa mumapulojekiti aaliwo aawo nobalembesya basikusololela; lugwasyo luunka kuli sikuyaka ooyu.

protection.placeholder: Mazuba aakukwabilila (atakwe chintu = nyika yoonse mbwiizulwa)
protection.hint: Kukwabililwa ziindi zyobile: mazuba aali 1-3650, naa kusiya kakunyina chintu kuti ubelesye nzila yanyika yoonse kuzwa kuZibambidwe. Kuchincha kulabeleka buyo kulibaabo bapya - aabo baliwo balabamba chiindi chabo.

matching.hint: Ino ntwaambo nzi tupa kuti kulilembya bobile babe kasitoma omwe wapulojekiti. Kuchincha kulabeleka kuma cheki aabili kuzwa lino; lukwabililo luliwo talujatikizyigwi pe.
